event.title: UN Committee Calls on Countries to Consider Reparations for Slavery's Legacy
event.canonical_title: UN Committee Calls on Countries to Consider Reparations for Slavery's Legacy
event.summary: A UN committee has stated that countries are legally required to consider reparations for the transatlantic slave trade. The guidance emphasizes the need for comprehensive measures to address the ongoing legacy of racial discrimination and systemic racism affecting people of African descent.

revisions.title: UN Committee States Countries Must Consider Reparations for Slavery Legacy
revisions.summary: A UN committee has declared that countries are legally required to consider reparations for the transatlantic slave trade. This guidance emphasizes the need for comprehensive measures to address the ongoing legacy of racial discrimination and systemic racism affecting people of African descent, as established by a legally binding convention from 1965.
